newsitem.title: USA: Florida governor says tobacco trial will go ahead.
newsitem.headline: Florida governor says tobacco trial will go ahead.

text.p: Florida Gov. Lawton Chiles on Friday said his state's lawsuit against U.S. cigarette companies was going to trial in August regardless of the outcome of national tobacco-litigation settlement talks.
"No matter who's talking settlement with whom, there's no doubt Florida's case is going to trial the first week of August, and a jury will get to hear the facts," Chiles said in a news release.

Chiles issued the remarks after a state judge allowed lawyers pressing Florida's case to use eight secret industry documents in the trial. The tobacco companies promised to appeal the ruling, and the documents remain secret pending a higher court's ruling.

The trial judge, Harold Cohen of Palm Beach County Circuit Court, also said in a written decision that the settlement talks, which have been going on since early April would not derail an August start of a trial.
